name: TinyStories
description: TinyStories is a synthetic dataset of short stories using vocabulary typical of 3 to 4-year-olds, generated by GPT-3.5 and GPT-4. It enables training and evaluation of very small language models (below 10 million parameters) to produce coherent, fluent, and diverse stories. The benchmark introduces a novel evaluation paradigm using GPT-4 as a grader to provide multidimensional scores on grammar, creativity, and consistency.
reputation: A widely used synthetic benchmark for studying small language models and controllable story generation, especially in the open-source community.
notes: Focuses on small LMs and simple architectures; introduces GPT-4 based grading framework for multidimensional evaluation.
